bibdata.title: Information security management framework
Information security management framework
bibdata.abstract: Recommendation ITU-T X.1052 provides best practices for information security management for telecommunication organizations to support Recommendation ITU-T X.1051. This Recommendation is based on a process approach to describe a set of security management areas, which give guidelines for telecommunication organizations to fulfil the control objectives defined in Recommendation ITU‑TX.1051. The management areas described in this Recommendation including asset management, incident management and risk management policy management, map the controls defined by Recommendation ITU-T X.1051 to achieve methodologies.
